The text's emergency CT and MRI sentences cite figures without naming panels, so they are not merged with the Figure 1 time-labelled CT panels or the Figure 2 MRI panels, which are recorded as separate caption-governed findings.

Discussion mentions emphysematous cystitis on imaging only as a general 'even when' statement, and vacuum suction as part of a general conclusion; neither is recorded as a fact of this patient. The Goldman 2005 case (44-year-old woman) is a cited literature case and is not this patient.

Discussion sentence on affected areas based on imaging is assigned to the index patient because it follows 'In our case' in the same paragraph of a single-case report; no imaging study or time is named for it.

'Once X were controlled, we initiated antimicrobial agents' is read as stating order (control of glucose, electrolytes and acid-base balance before antimicrobial start), like 'following'. The ultrasound-guided drainage sentence before it carries no order word and is not ordered against them.

She failed to comply with glucose monitoring and glibenclamide.
